needs.family: Large-breed puppy dry kibble (beef-free)
needs.description: Complete large-breed puppy dry kibble formulated for growth-phase dogs (for 7-month-old large-breed puppy), beef-free protein (e.g., chicken, turkey, or fish), controlled calcium/phosphorus for healthy bone growth, size-specific kibble (medium-large pieces) and 25-30%+ protein with DHA for brain development. Sold in 10–30 lb bags appropriate to weekly feeding needs.
needs.rationale: 7-month-old Golden Retriever is still in growth phase and benefits from a large-breed puppy formula to support proper skeletal development and avoid excess growth stress; must avoid beef due to reported allergy. This is a daily consumable — immediate nutritional need right now.
evidence: standard: large-breed puppy nutrition guidelines (controlled growth nutrients)

needs.family: Biodegradable poop bags (walk bag refill rolls)
needs.description: Durable, leak-resistant biodegradable dog waste bags on refill rolls, standard 9x13 inch size, scented or unscented options, dispenser-compatible for attachment to leash or harness. Pack sizes: 60-240 bags.
needs.rationale: Apartment living with no yard means daily outdoor potty on walks — waste bags are a daily consumable and required for hygiene and local ordinances.

needs.family: 6-foot flat leash (standard nylon or biothane)
needs.description: Standard 6-foot leash (nylon or biothane) with secure clasp, comfortable handle, moderate width (3/4"–1"), suitable for urban walks and apartment exits. Lightweight but durable for a light chewer puppy.
needs.rationale: Immediate safety item for outdoor movement; without a leash the dog would be at risk in public spaces. Apartment living requires daily controlled walks.

needs.family: Front-clip or no-pull harness (adjustable, padded)
needs.description: Adjustable padded harness sized for a 7-month-old Golden Retriever (look for 'medium/large adjustable' with chest girth sizing), front-clip option to reduce pulling and increase control, breathable mesh for comfort during warm weather.
needs.rationale: Provides safer control than a collar on a growing retriever and reduces risk of neck injury; essential for safe apartment-to-outside transitions and leash walks.

needs.family: ID tag (engraved) for collar
needs.description: Durable engraved ID tag (stainless steel or aluminum) sized for dog collar with name, phone number, and city; single-line or double-line engraving, with split ring attachment.
needs.rationale: Immediate safety: if dog gets loose during apartment or neighborhood walks (no yard), an ID tag is required to reunite quickly. Microchipping is a service; tag is a product immediate need.

needs.family: Collapsible travel water bowl
needs.description: Collapsible silicone or fabric travel bowl (portable, lightweight) for walks and outings, holds ~16–24 oz, foldable or carabiner-attachable, easy-to-clean, suitable for hot-weather hydration.
needs.rationale: Active outdoor time in an apartment lifestyle requires portable water access. Current excessive-heat warning increases the importance of carrying water to prevent overheating and dehydration on walks.

needs.family: Deshedding tool / undercoat rake for double-coated breeds
needs.description: Long-toothed undercoat rake or de-shedding tool sized for medium-to-large double-coated breeds, ergonomic handle, stainless teeth, safe for Golden Retriever coat to remove loose undercoat without damaging topcoat.
needs.rationale: Pet is in fall shedding season (Golden Retrievers double-coat) and apartment living increases hair accumulation indoors; deshedding tools reduce fur around the home and help manage allergens during fall allergy season.

needs.family: Pet hair vacuum attachment or handheld pet vacuum
needs.description: Handheld vacuum or vacuum attachment specifically designed for pet hair removal (motorized brush head), compact for apartment use to clear shedding Golden hair from carpets and upholstery.
needs.rationale: High shedding breed in apartment requires extra cleaning tools to maintain indoor air quality during fall allergy season and reduce hair build-up.

needs.family: Dog toothbrush and enzymatic toothpaste (beef-free flavor)
needs.description: Dual-headed dog toothbrush or finger brush plus enzymatic dog toothpaste in a non-beef flavor (chicken, poultry, or unflavored), toothpaste specifically for pets (non-toxic), starter kit for 7-month-old puppy.
needs.rationale: Dental care beginning in puppyhood reduces plaque buildup; dental hygiene is a preventive best practice and many guidelines recommend starting toothbrushing by 6–8 months.

needs.family: Dental chews (age-appropriate, beef-free)
needs.description: Dental chews sized for medium-large puppies, enzymatic or textured to help remove plaque, specifically labeled safe for puppies 7 months+, beef-free ingredients.
needs.rationale: Adjunct to brushing; helps reduce plaque and supports dental health as puppy transitions to adult, consistent with veterinary preventive care practices.

needs.family: Dog nail clippers / grinder (pet nail trimmer)
needs.description: Scissor or guillotine-style nail clippers sized for medium-large dogs, or a low-speed nail grinder with diamond bit, non-slip grip, and safety guard.
needs.rationale: Regular nail trimmings prevent overgrowth and paw problems, especially for indoor apartment dogs that may not naturally wear nails down.

needs.family: Tick removal tool and fine-tooth flea/tick comb
needs.description: Simple tick removal tweezer or hook tool (plastic or stainless) and a fine-tooth metal flea/tick comb for regular checks after walks; portable and non-medical.
needs.rationale: Hunting and outdoor seasons increase risk of ticks and fleas; while medications are not recommended here, tools for detection/removal and combing are preventive hygiene tools.

needs.family: LED clip or reflective vest for walks
needs.description: Small LED clip or reflective vest/collar strip to attach for dawn/dusk walks or noisy outdoor seasons; lightweight, rechargeable or battery-operated visibility item.
needs.rationale: Hunting season and reduced visibility on early/late walks make added visibility a recommended precaution for outdoor safety on neighborhood walks.

needs.family: Slow-feeder bowl / puzzle feeder (food-dispensing slow feeder)
needs.description: Slow-feeder bowl or simple food puzzle sized for medium-large puppies to slow ingestion and provide mental stimulation during meals; dishwasher-safe, non-toxic plastic or ceramic.
needs.rationale: Large-breed dogs are at risk for gulping/bloat; a slow feeder reduces gulping and provides preventive support. Also useful in apartment for mental engagement.
evidence: standard: slow feeding to reduce gulping and bloat risk

needs.family: Indoor potty option (training pads or artificial grass patch)
needs.description: Absorbent training pads or small artificial grass patch for occasional indoor potty use; leak-proof tray included for pads or turf with drainage for grass patch, sized for apartment use.
needs.rationale: No-yard apartment living plus potential rainy season or long schedule changes (school year) can make occasional indoor potty solutions useful for a young rescue still solidifying routine.

needs.family: Dog-appeasing pheromone diffuser or plug-in (non-medical)
needs.description: Electric plug-in dog-appeasing pheromone diffuser for indoor use (non-medical calming aid) to reduce noise-related anxiety from leaf blowers and hunting-related noises, suitable for apartment rooms.
needs.rationale: Calendar events note leaf blower and hunting seasons that can be stress-inducing for rescue dogs; a pheromone diffuser is a non-medical preventive calming tool.

needs.family: Durable rubber treat-dispensing toy (light chewer)
needs.description: Soft-to-medium density rubber treat-dispensing toy sized for medium-large dogs (holes adjustable for kibble/treats), suitable for light chewers, dishwasher-safe; encourages mental stimulation and independent play.
needs.rationale: Low-activity apartment dog benefits from mental enrichment; treat-dispensing toys reduce boredom and give controlled activity indoors.

needs.family: Elevated or cushioned indoor dog bed (washable)
needs.description: Medium-large washable dog bed with bolsters or low-profile elevated design for joint comfort, machine-washable cover, appropriately sized for a young Golden Retriever to rest indoors in an apartment.
needs.rationale: Provides a comfortable, designated resting place indoors and helps the dog settle; useful in apartment to keep dog off cold floors and create a secure den-like spot.

needs.family: Soft indoor fetch ball (lightweight, non-abrasive)
needs.description: Soft, indoor-safe ball sized for medium-large dogs (foam or soft rubber) that won't damage apartment walls or furniture; bounce appropriate for short indoor fetch sessions.
needs.rationale: Low-impact physical activity that can be done inside to expend energy without needing a yard; supports bonding and basic retrieval instincts typical for retriever breeds.

needs.family: Snuffle mat (foraging slow-feeder)
needs.description: Fabric snuffle mat with layered pockets to hide kibble or treats, machine-washable, size appropriate for medium-large dogs to encourage scent work and slow feeding.
needs.rationale: Encourages natural foraging behavior and mental stimulation indoors in an apartment setting—useful on rainy days and for low-activity dogs.

needs.family: Cooling mat (non-electrical gel or breathable fabric)
needs.description: Non-electrical cooling mat sized for medium-large dogs that provides evaporative or gel-based cooling for use indoors during warm days; machine-friendly cover and portable.
needs.rationale: Provides comfort during heat spells and helps temperature regulation in apartments without AC; relevant during excessive-heat warnings and upcoming warm days.

needs.family: Plush comfort toys (soft, minimal stuffing)
needs.description: Soft plush toys designed for light chewers with minimal loose stuffing and reinforced seams; several small-sized toys for comfort and cuddling.
needs.rationale: Rescue puppy may benefit from comfort objects for anxiety reduction and companionship in an apartment environment; light chew strength suits plush options.

needs.family: Flirt pole (indoor-safe short version)
needs.description: Compact flirt pole or teaser wand sized for indoor use with a short handle and durable toy end, suitable for light play and impulse control training in small spaces.
needs.rationale: Provides short bursts of high-value play and helps practice impulse control and recall indoors in an apartment setting without needing a yard.

needs.family: Training clicker and treat pouch
needs.description: Basic training clicker and a small treat pouch (belt-attachable) for reward-based training sessions; pouch sized for small training treats, easy-access closure.
needs.rationale: Useful for reinforcing good behavior, leash manners, and apartment-appropriate cues; supports routine adjustments referenced by school-year schedule and ongoing puppy socialization.

needs.family: Soft chew toys / puppy teething toys (non-toxic)
needs.description: Soft rubber or fabric teething toys sized for puppies, non-toxic materials, designed for light chewers to chew and gnaw safely during teething periods.
needs.rationale: 7-month puppy may still be teething/ mouthing; light-chew-strength appropriate toys preserve dental comfort and reduce destructive chewing behavior indoors.

needs.family: Window perch pad or small elevated bed
needs.description: Compact window perch pad or foam bed that can be placed near a window for safe outward viewing; washable cover and non-slip base for apartment windowsills or floor placement.
needs.rationale: Golden Retrievers enjoy visual stimulation; a window perch provides mental enrichment and reduces boredom in an apartment environment.
